visualCharacteristics.purpose: image grid with a short caption under each image
visualCharacteristics.layout: responsive grid (4-up on desktop, fewer items fill the row), caption centred below the image; image keeps its own crop/aspect from the URL

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = image (picture, image link or plain-text image URL; Dynamic Media crop/flip/colorize parameters used as authored); cell 2 = short caption text

usage: Before/after or transformation showcases (crop variants, color transformations, composite imaging).
reuseGuidance: Use for any image + caption grid with 2-4 items per row. If cards need a CTA or longer body, use cards-promo.
